records.title: Training data bias causes inaccurate clinical AI recommendations
records.rationale: Biased or unrepresentative training data could cause the clinical AI model to produce inaccurate recommendations for certain patient populations. The likelihood is possible because bias may be introduced during data collection or model training, while the impact is severe because incorrect clinical recommendations could affect patient care.

records.title: Unauthorized user exploits inadequate data access restrictions causing sensitive data exposure to Financial Risk Training Data Repository
records.rationale: Training repositories may contain sensitive financial or customer information accessible to model-development personnel. Inadequate access restrictions could expose this information. The likelihood is possible, while the impact is major because exposure could create privacy, regulatory, and reputational consequences.

records.title: Unauthorized developer exploits excessive privileges causing unapproved model changes to AI Model Training Server
records.rationale: Developers with excessive privileges could alter model configurations, training parameters, or code without appropriate authorization. The likelihood is possible in a collaborative development environment, while the impact is major because unauthorized changes could affect model integrity and downstream production decisions.
